bio: This restaurant in a residential area in Maintal-Dörnigheim brings a slice of France to the Rhine-Main area. You can look forward to experiencing French-Mediterranean flair, both in terms of the feel of the place and Patrick Theumer's seasonally influenced cuisine. The three set menus, one of which is vegetarian, are particularly appealing. Friendly service. It is also pleasant to dine on the beautifully verdant terrace....
